# Vestra Player SDK

> @vestra-player/sdk 1.5.54: write plugins for Vestra Player in TypeScript (plugin API `vestra/1`). A plugin is a folder with `manifest.json` and an entry module whose default export `activate(plugin)` the player calls. The documentation is a tree of short pages read by path, like `go doc`: the same pages and API as https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/.

## Read the documentation

- **Command line** (any coding agent): `npx -p @vestra-player/sdk vestra-plugin docs [path] [--page N]` prints one node of the tree; `npx -p @vestra-player/sdk vestra-plugin docs --search <words>` lists the matching paths. In a project that depends on the SDK, `npx vestra-plugin docs` is enough.
- **In a Node.js program**: `import { docs, searchDocs } from "@vestra-player/sdk/docs"`; `docs(path, { page })` and `searchDocs(query, { page })` return the same text.
- **Paths**: `/` lists the top level; every answer lists the paths one level down with a one-line summary. `/API/<category>/<symbol>/<member>` is one declaration with its signature, parameters, return value, errors, capability, player version and examples, for example `/API/Media/Snapshot/dispose`. `/Guides/<group>/<page>` is a page of the site, for example `/Guides/How-to/Test a plugin` (the file name works too: `/Guides/How-to/testing`). Case, spaces and punctuation do not matter, the leading `/` is optional, `.` works like `/`, a name alone finds its declaration (`TestHost`, `Snapshot.export`, `plugin.player`), and `#heading` opens the page of a long answer that has that section.
- **Size**: every answer is at most 8 KB; a longer one ends with the number of its next page (`--page 2`).
- **Before writing code**, read `/Guides/Tutorials/Getting started` and `/Guides/Guidelines`, then the API of what you use. Test with `/Guides/How-to/Test a plugin`.

## Top level

- `/Overview`: The package's README: what the SDK is, installing it and where to start.
- `/Guides`: The documentation pages, by group: tutorials, how-to guides, reference, explanation, guidelines, examples, upgrading.
- `/API`: Every type and value of @vestra-player/sdk (the plugin API), @vestra-player/sdk/testing (the test host) and @vestra-player/sdk/docs (this tree), by category.

## Guides

- `/Guides/Tutorials`: Step-by-step lessons; the first four build one plugin, from an empty folder to a tested package in the plugin store.
- `/Guides/How-to`: Short guides that each answer one practical question about writing, translating, testing or publishing a plugin.
- `/Guides/Reference`: Lookup tables that span many symbols (capabilities, manifest fields and player versions, limits, menu and binding names, platform differences, theme, command line), generated from the SDK's code.
- `/Guides/Explanation`: What each part of the player and its plugins is, why it works the way it does and how the parts fit together.
- `/Guides/Guidelines`: The rules a plugin follows so that its windows, panels, messages and menu items look and behave like the rest of Vestra Player.
- `/Guides/Examples`: Complete, tested example plugins with a screenshot each and a step-by-step walkthrough of their code.
- `/Guides/Upgrading`: What to change in a plugin when an SDK or player release deprecates, removes or changes something it uses.

## API

- `/API/Commands`: 15 entries: CommandState, Bindable, Condition, When, MenuId, BarButtonIcon, CommandButton, CommandOptions, Command, Commands, HostAction, Host, BindingRef, BindingInfo, Bindings
- `/API/Media`: 6 entries: CaptureOptions, Snapshot, ExportOptions, JobState, ExportJob, MediaCapture
- `/API/Packages`: 10 entries: PackageManifest, PackageSource, InstallOptions, PackageCandidate, PackageChangeStatus, PackageChange, PluginInfo, PluginDisplay, PluginWarning, Packages
- `/API/Playback`: 18 entries: MarkKind, TimelineMark, TimelineLayer, Timeline, AudioTrack, PlayerState, AudioDevice, Chapter, Conditional, Media, Scrub, StreamFrame, StreamOptions, StreamStartError, Stream,…
- `/API/Plugin`: 13 entries: Disposable, PluginError, Scope, Plugin, StopReason, DisposeInfo, WindowState, MainWindow, AppInfo, App, SystemInfo, DisplayInfo, Json
- `/API/Processing`: 18 entries: FilterStatus, VideoFilter, AudioFilter, ViewSettings, VideoView, RenderSettings, RenderOptions, VideoShaders, UpscalingReasonCode, UpscalingReason, UpscalingDecodingCause,…
- `/API/Services`: 15 entries: Clipboard, Power, ToolResult, Tools, JsonStore, Storage, SessionStorage, System, Secrets, RenderingMode, RenderingPreference, RenderingReasonCode, RenderingReason, RenderingState,…
- `/API/Sources`: 7 entries: ResolverOptions, WebResolverOptions, FileResolverOptions, ResolvedStream, Resolver, Resolvers, ResolvedMedia
- `/API/Subtitles`: 5 entries: SubtitleTrack, SubtitlesState, SubtitleConditional, Subtitles, SubtitleStyle
- `/API/UI`: 42 entries: ImageRef, ImageOptions, MarkdownRef, MarkdownOptions, PropValue, PropData, Props, Ui, View, Window, Windows, SlotState, SlotPanel, PanelState, PanelSlot, SidebarSlot, Panel,…
- `/API/Testing`: 32 entries: CapabilityInfo, CAPABILITY_INFO, MESSAGE_LIMIT, COMMAND_LIMITS, MENU_IDS, BAR_BUTTON_ICONS, BAR_BUTTON_LIMITS, BuiltinSubmenu, BUILTIN_SUBMENUS, BuiltinCommand, BUILTIN_COMMANDS, LOCALES,…
- `/API/Docs`: 4 entries: DOCS_PAGE_BYTES, DocsOptions, docs, searchDocs
